clips.title: The story
paras: High Priest Rohan awaits in Ironforge to test the resilience of promising dwarven disciples. In the Mystic Ward, he offers teachings shaped for their growing strength of spirit.

Priests serving the Alliance abroad are sent by local mentors to report to senior clergy of their order. Dwarven disciples answer that summons in Ironforge's Mystic Ward, where High Priest Rohan awaits. There, basic spiritual practice gives way to deeper uses of holy magic, tested through trials.

Dwarven tradition teaches that the Light is both a shield and a strong defense in physical conflict. Reporting to High Priest Rohan shows that an initiate has endured the wider world's trials and has the mettle to master fear on the front lines.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Friend, your High Priest Rohan would have an audience with you in Ironforge. Make haste, my strong friend, your next test quickly approaches. Although I wish I could bear witness to your race's own special rites, my place is here. But may the Light go with you in your travels. Rohan should still be in the Mystic Ward once you reach the city. He will be waiting.

clips.title: Completion
paras: You've got the makings of a great adventurer, friend. Keep up the good work!
You've already shown you're ready for battle. Perhaps it's time we taught ya a little somethin' more.
